title: WorkingOrder
description: Pending order resting at the broker and not yet filled, cancelled or expired.

type.description: Raw MT5 pending order type: 2=buy limit, 3=sell limit, 4=buy stop, 5=sell stop.

volume.description: Remaining volume of the pending order in lots.

price.description: Trigger price of the pending order.

sl.description: Stop loss level to attach when the order fills. Zero means none.

tp.description: Take profit level to attach when the order fills. Zero means none.

expiration.description: Expiration instant in epoch seconds UTC, or null for good-till-cancelled.
